insights.summary: Q1 FY27 revenue was about ₹162 Cr (up from ₹111 Cr a year ago), in line with the ₹150-160 Cr guided. Management raised FY27 revenue guidance to ₹700-720 Cr (from ₹650-700 Cr) at 26-27% EBITDA margin, guided 25-30% growth for FY28, and set a new goal of ₹1,500 Cr by FY30, excluding hormones and biologics. Oncology was cut to ₹100-110 Cr for FY27 as its registrations slip to Q4, while general-injectable registrations in Mexico and MENA drive growth.

what_changed.text: FY27 revenue guidance raised to ₹700-720 Cr from ₹650-700 Cr
FY30 goal of ₹1,500 Cr revenue; FY28 growth 25-30%
FY27 oncology revenue now ₹100-110 Cr vs ₹150 Cr guided in May
KPMG appointment moved to Q3-Q4 FY27 (needs an EGM)
EPO clinical trials approved, starting Nov-Dec 2026; Keytruda biosimilar pre-clinical from December

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: But this financial year, we do believe that 100% the sales will cross the INR700 crores or INR720 crores mark.

analyst_questions.answer: Kaler was set up with a business associate tied to partner Mana Pharma for an oncology plant; the plant is on hold and the land may be sold.
KPMG to be appointed at an EGM, with Q3 or Q4 FY27 audited by them; software upgrades are causing the delay.
Debtor days about 165-170, aiming for 155-160 in normal operations; receivables about 40% of revenue.
Many certified plants and ready dossiers; 60-70 registrations in the last three quarters, each worth about $1.5-2 million a year.

red_flags.text: Questions on a related-party land purchase (Kaler Biopharma) reportedly at double the price; project on hold.
Big-four auditor appointment keeps slipping (promised 'next quarter' in May, now Q3-Q4 FY27).
Receivables about 40% of annual revenue; debtor days 165-170.
Inconsistent figures: oncology '25-30% of revenue' vs ₹100-110 Cr; CFO says he guides low so fewer questions come later.

watch_next: Q2 FY27 revenue in the ₹160-170 Cr range

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Generic injectables and oral products across five plants (general, oncology, beta-lactam, cephalosporin, biologics), hormone plant from November 2026
business_snapshot.customers: Distribution partners and government tenders in Mexico, Colombia, Algeria, Morocco, Tunisia, GCC and CIS; partner Mana Pharma and SD Biopharmaceuticals
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: LATAM 35-40% of FY27 revenue; general-injectable registrations growing faster than oncology
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Quarterly product registrations (six to seven expected each quarter), first and second generics, biosimilars after patent expiry
